# Chat (all platforms) triggers

## Activity (any platform)

Runs when something happens on any platform, like a follow, a subscription, a tip or a raid. One trigger for the same event everywhere.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Pick one platform, or "All" to react to events from all of them. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Kind** | The kind of event to react to, like Follow, Tip or Raid. "Any" runs for every kind. "Other" is anything that fits no kind. Options: Any, Follow, Subscription, GiftSubscription, Tip, Raid, Redemption, StreamOnline, StreamOffline, Other. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%platform%` | Where it happened |
| `%kind%` | What kind of event it was |
| `%user%` | Name of the person |
| `%title%` | A short line about it, like "Alice followed" |
| `%detail%` | More information, if there is any |
| `%amount%` | The amount, like $5.00, if money or points were involved |

<small>Type id: `chat.activity`</small>

## Chat message (any platform)

Runs when someone writes in the chat of any connected platform, or just one. Use it for things that should work everywhere.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Pick one platform, or "All" to react to chat from all of them. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%platform%` | Where it was written, like Twitch or Kick |
| `%user%` | Name of the person who wrote |
| `%userId%` | Their ID on that platform |
| `%message%` | What they wrote |
| `%messageId%` | ID of the message |
| `%isBroadcaster%` | True if it is you |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isVip%` | True if they are a VIP |
| `%isSubscriber%` | True if they are a subscriber |

<small>Type id: `chat.message`</small>

## Emote added

Runs when a new emote appears in a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote set (add-ons that give chat extra emotes). Cuebot rechecks every so often.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Provider** | Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them. Options: Any, 7TV, BTTV, FFZ. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%emote%` | Name of the new emote |
| `%emoteId%` | ID of the emote |
| `%provider%` | Which add-on it is from |
| `%platform%` | Which platform's set it is in |
| `%imageUrl%` | Web link to the emote picture |

<small>Type id: `chat.emoteAdded`</small>

## Emote removed

Runs when an emote disappears from a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote set (add-ons that give chat extra emotes). Cuebot rechecks every so often.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Provider** | Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them. Options: Any, 7TV, BTTV, FFZ. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%emote%` | Name of the removed emote |
| `%emoteId%` | ID of the emote |
| `%provider%` | Which add-on it was from |
| `%platform%` | Which platform's set it was in |

<small>Type id: `chat.emoteRemoved`</small>

## Emote set changed

Runs once after a check finds changes in an emote set, however many emotes changed. Use it for a single summary instead of one run per emote.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Provider** | Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them. Options: Any, 7TV, BTTV, FFZ. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%provider%` | Which add-on changed |
| `%platform%` | Which platform's set changed |
| `%added%` | Names of the new emotes, separated by commas |
| `%removed%` | Names of the removed emotes, separated by commas |
| `%addedCount%` | How many were added |
| `%removedCount%` | How many were removed |

<small>Type id: `chat.emotesChanged`</small>
